name: YHA Broad Haven
accommodation: Dorm beds, private rooms (some en suite), pitch-up camping and whole-hostel hire; groups of 16 to 77
suitableFor: Solo travellers, families, budget surf trips and groups
parking: Nearby National Park car park with hostel ticket
dogs: Not allowed in rooms; allowed in café, Camping & Cabins and exclusive hire; assistance dogs welcome
beachAccess: About 100m from the Blue Flag beach
boardStorage: Not stated; cycle store and drying rooms listed
confirmedFeatures: Cycle store, luggage store, self-catering kitchen, café, restaurant, licensed bar, laundry, drying rooms, games area, garden, Wi-Fi in social spaces, wheelchair accessible
overview: YHA Broad Haven is a modern hostel right behind the beach, about 100 metres from the sand. It offers dorm beds, private rooms and camping, with a café, bar, self-catering kitchen and drying rooms. Parking is in the National Park car park opposite.
surfTripFit: You can walk to the waves in a couple of minutes, and the drying rooms and self-catering kitchen keep a surf trip cheap and simple.
